headline: GW7: 90 mins to Deadline Thread
body: A straight forward home game, A straight forward captaincy decision. Are you sticking with the Big man or are you unnecessarily complicating things for your team? Have you saved your chips for this long and planning to use any? Have you set your bench order correctly and made sure there's no room for regret? Have you sold a perfectly solid player just because they failed to return for two game in a row? Whatever you have done or will do. Make sure you don't miss the deadline and save your team.   submitted by   /u/6by6Hindsight [link]   [comments]
